answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% component spend reduction this year; the incumbent has explicitly refused to adjust pricing. Memory_c2 documents a prior successful migration to a low-cost vendor that delivered sharp unit cost reductions with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. Given the contract's imminent expiration (14 days) and the non-negotiable cost mandate, switching primary vendors offers the most direct path to achieving the required savings. The elevated delivery risk due to 94% line utilization is acknowledged but considered acceptable given the prior success (memory_c2) and the critical nature of the cost mandate. Renewal (memory_c1) or negotiation (memory_c4) cannot meet the 18% target under current constraints, and multi-year commitments (memory_c6) are blocked by the incumbent's refusal.
